_meta.note: 12 real distinct beaches; 3 nudist deferred; Μεγάλη Βλυχάδα renamed from OSM MIKRI VLYHADA per verification.

beaches.verifyReason: Multiple independent Crete beach guides (cretanbeaches.com, cretelocals.com, creteinfo.gr, terrabook) document Κορφαλώνας as a real sandy/pebble swimmable beach with sunbeds/showers in Kissamos, Chania; it is the central section between Livadia and Drapanias, distinct from our nearest "Τελώνιο" which is the westernmost town section ~1.6km west, and clearly in Greece not Turkey/Albania.

Multiple independent guides (Greeka, cretanbeaches, cretelocals, discovercrete, explorecrete) describe Drapanias as a real ~2km organized sandy/pebble swimmable beach 5km east of Kissamos near Korfalonas/Nopigia; the nearest existing "Telonio" is a separate westernmost section in Kissamos town (~23.657 lon vs candidate ~23.697 lon), so it is genuinely distinct.

Multiple independent travel sources (Lovin' Corfu, AtCorfu, Navicup, Wikimapia) confirm Vouvalomantria is a real ~30m pebble swimmable beach in Corfu's Erimitis nature reserve (Municipal Unit of Kassiopi, Greece), accessible only by boat/foot and distinct from road-accessible Kogevina Beach near Kassiopi (~1.3km away); the missing Google place is expected for a remote unorganized beach.

OSM way 93887501 is tagged natural=beach (Βραχλή/Vrahli) and multiple independent Corfu sources (atcorfu.com, corfuland.gr) confirm it as a distinct swimmable pebble cove in the Erimitis area of NE Corfu, Greece, separate from Kogevina beach (~1.2km away in Bolana Bay), accessed by footpath/sea.

Multiple independent travel sources (mykerkyra, lovincorfu, greeka, feelgreece, hestiatravel, TripAdvisor) plus OSM's natural-beach tagging confirm Chouchoulio is a real unorganized pebble/gravel swimmable beach in its own bay by Kouloura port (Kalami/Gimari, North Corfu, Greece), distinct from our nearby Gialiskari/Gimari beach ~1km away.

OSM tags it natural=beach and multiple Corfu guides (AtCorfu, Lovin' Corfu, beaches-searcher) confirm Tzoufaka is a real, named virgin pebble cove in the Erimitis peninsula (NE Corfu near Agios Stefanos), distinct from both Avlaki and our nearest Kogevina Beach (a separate cove in Bolana Bay ~1431m away); reverse geocode confirms it is in Greece (GR), not Albania.

Greek travel source (allovergreece) confirms Agia Eleni as a real small pebbled swimmable beach below the Agia Eleni church near Chios airport/Lefkonas, explicitly distinct from nearby Karfas (our nearest at 976m); coords 38.328/26.160 are on SE Chios, clearly in Greece, and no Eleni entry exists in our 35-beach Chios dataset.

OSM way 450780778 (natural=beach, NE Amorgos near Tholaria) sits at lon 26.0019, ~2.2km EAST of our existing Mikri Vlychada (lon 25.97745, at Tholaria's longitude, 0.9km away); sources state Mikri is the WESTERN cove and the eastern beach 1.8km from Tholaria is Megali Vlychada, and the OSM way borders "Όρμος Μεγάλη Βλιχάδα" bay — so it is a real, distinct, boat/foot-access Greek swimmable beach we lack (the eastern Vlychada/Megali cove), mislabeled "Mikri" in OSM (only a name:fr tag) and should be added under the correct name Μεγάλη Βλυχάδα rather than as a duplicate of our existing Μικρή Βλυχάδα.

OSM way/320088015 (natural=beach, surface=sand) at 39.320,23.015 matches ilovepelion's Παραλία Καρνάγιο / Καρνάγιο Πούντα at Κάτω Λεχώνια (coords 39.31946,23.01533), locally nicknamed "Καλαμιές" for its shoreline reeds — a real public swimmable Pelion beach in Greece, distinct from our "Καλαμιές (Αγριά)" which sits ~3.3 km NW at lon 22.989 in a different village (Agria).

Lalaria is a famous iconic white-pebble swimmable beach on NE Skiathos, Greece (OSM natural=beach; widely documented as a top boat-access beach), clearly distinct from our nearest entry Παραλία Τσουγκριάς, which is a different islet off Skiathos's south coast.

Νηές is a confirmed real coastal settlement of Sourpi (Almyros, Magnesia) on the Pagasetic Gulf with its own named bay enclosed by Cape Glaros; municipal and Wikipedia sources describe a shallow public sand/pebble beach ideal for swimming, located ~7.2 km from our nearest entry Συκίτσα, so it is a distinct mainland-Greek beach we lack.

Chrisi Milia is Alonissos' famous golden-sand beach (own TripAdvisor/Greeka/AllOverGreece pages, OSM way/296512536 tagged natural=beach); Greeka lists it as a separate beach from the nearby pebble "Milia" (our existing Αλόννησος Μηλιά ~860m W, OSM surface=pebblestone), so it is a genuine distinct Greek swimmable beach we lack.
